property_summary: For any actor other than the deployer-admin, setOwner always reverts and leaves owner unchanged; the mutant checks the guard against owner, so once the admin has transferred ownership to that actor, the actor can successfully re-transfer owner, breaking the invariant.
change_summary: Change the onlyAdmin guard to check msg.sender against owner instead of admin, allowing different callers to set owner.
